name: zvideo_dd3d_begin_scene_flush_pending_render_states
description: zVideo_dd3d::BeginSceneAndFlushPendingRenderStates opens a Direct3D scene and flushes deferred fill-mode and dither render states.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to a coherent zVideo Direct3D scene/render-state pass because final call shape depends on Direct3D provider ABI and adjacent scene enter/leave wrappers.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4a9ac0 validates IDirect3DDevice2::BeginScene, zVideo_dd::ReportError on nonzero HRESULT with zvid_ddd3d.c line 76, pending wireframe state 0/1 mapped to fill-mode solid/wireframe and reset to -1, and pending dither state flushed to render state 26 then reset to -1.

The native fake-Direct3D smoke verifies BeginScene success, solid and wireframe fill-mode flushes, dither flush and reset, and BeginScene failure preserving both pending states without SetRenderState calls.
